verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.sprinto.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured documentation index. Markdown versions of the docs pages are also served (.md endpoints that point back to llms.txt), and many doc citations resolve to .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle, no first-party guidance on agent consumption of the docs, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).
